seen: Extreme low angle against a cloudy sky: red-haired rogue (left) in a mid-air leap, dagger raised high in her right hand, second dagger low; the knight (right) leaning back at a diagonal, big curved blade held out to the right. Both look airborne or off balance; grassy hill at the bottom right. No monsters.
action: {rogue} drops out of her leap and slashes her raised dagger down at {knight}. Leaning back, he whips his big blade across to meet it. The blades clash between them with a flash of sparks, and the impact throws them apart, her red hair whipping behind her while he twists away.
camera: The camera stays low and tilts up slightly to follow them. Clouds drift slowly behind.
plot_ru: Кадр 3 (низкий ракурс, небо). В кадре не гоблин, а рыцарь: разбойница в прыжке рубит кинжалом сверху, рыцарь встречает клинком, искры, удар разносит их в стороны. Камера снизу, чуть вверх за ними.
